verdict.rationale: Testing workflows with sample or pinned data and inspecting each step's input and output is a fair question for a workflow-automation product like Zapier, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of either capability. The only nearby items are troubleshooting docs for errors in Zap workflows and AI-generated troubleshooting instructions. Those cover diagnosing errors after the fact, not pre-launch testing with sample data or per-step inspection, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can test a workflow with sample or pinned data and inspect each step's input and output before going live
